zh.simulation: 教学模型 · 不运行真实 Agent 或外部命令
zh.codeNote: 下方为源码节选或明确标注的设计概括；交互情境均为教学示意。
zh.fallback: 启用 JavaScript 可操作图解；静态图、结论和来源无需 JavaScript。
zh.title: 用户还没下指令，可以先做什么？
zh.lead: 切换主动接单模式与调查结果，观察何时执行、何时只记录、何时安静结束。
zh.diagramLabel: 主动接单和投机执行的分支流程
zh.simple: 问题可复现，存在简单修复
zh.message: 群聊：登录偶尔失败，好像与重试有关。没有直接 @ Agent。
zh.rule: 教学前提：已监听该群、发送者/来源符合准入条件，团队启用了“安静复现简单问题”规则。
zh.accepted: ✓ 匹配规则；创建 inferred Mandate
zh.observeWork: ■ 不创建 Worker，不实际复现
zh.working: ▶ 隔离环境内复现与验证
zh.ready: ✓ 已验证简单修复，准备可审阅结果
zh.discard: ■ 无有效修复结果，结束后台探索
zh.needsDecision: ◇ 超出简单修复范围，不自行做产品决定
zh.deliver: → 交付有用且已验证的结果；合并仍服从团队规则
zh.caption: 投机执行用额外后台计算换取准备时间；它不是绕过授权，也不意味着每条反馈都自动变成 PR。
zh.limit0: 原型默认 observe；图中的调查分支只有 auto 才实际推进。这些结果是虚构情境，不是运行记录。
zh.limit1: 规则的流程与沟通要求可以覆盖默认行为；此页选择了安静探索的规则，不是所有任务都静默。
zh.limit2: 不能复现并不证明没有 bug；不交付猜测性修复也不意味着系统已解决诊断与安全问题。
zh.question: observe 与 auto 的差别只在是否通知用户吗？
zh.answer: 不是。observe 不实际接单、创建 Worker 或执行复现；auto 才能在符合策略后开始主动工作。
zh.step0Explanation: 系统读取被允许监听的事件；尚未把它当作人明确下达的命令。
zh.step1Explanation: 代码准入之后才做语义判断。observe 的正面判断记录为 would_accept，不启动任务。
zh.step2Title: 只有被允许的分支开始工作
zh.step2Explanation: auto 且匹配启用规则时才能创建任务。后台探索会占用计算资源，即使最终没有结果。
zh.step3Explanation: 简单修复、无法复现、产品决策是不同结果。结果是否有用与是否获准对外动作都需要判断。

en.simulation: Teaching model · No real agents or external commands
en.codeNote: Below: source excerpts or explicitly labeled design summaries. Interactive scenarios are illustrative.
en.fallback: Enable JavaScript to operate the figure. The static diagram, conclusion, and sources work without it.
en.title: What can an agent prepare before being asked?
en.lead: Switch acceptance mode and investigation outcome to see when work runs, is only recorded, or ends quietly.
en.diagramLabel: Branches for proactive acceptance and speculative execution
en.auto: auto: accept after a matching rule
en.simple: Reproducible issue with a simple fix
en.message: Chat: login sometimes fails, perhaps due to retries. Nobody directly addresses the agent.
en.rule: Teaching prerequisites: the chat is listened to, source/sender admission passes, and a team rule permits quiet reproduction of simple issues.
en.accepted: ✓ Rule matches; create an inferred Mandate
en.working: ▶ Reproduce and verify in an isolated environment
en.ready: ✓ Simple fix verified; prepare a reviewable result
en.discard: ■ No useful fix; end background exploration
en.needsDecision: ◇ Beyond a simple fix; do not decide product behavior
en.deliver: → Deliver a useful verified result; merging still follows team rules
en.caption: Speculation spends background compute on preparation. It neither bypasses authorization nor turns every report into a PR.
en.limit0: The prototype defaults to observe. Only auto advances the illustrated investigation. Outcomes are fictional, not execution traces.
en.limit1: Rule-specific process and communication can override defaults. This page assumes a quiet-investigation rule, not universal silence.
en.limit2: Failure to reproduce does not prove there is no bug. Withholding a speculative fix does not solve diagnosis or safety in general.
en.question: Is notification the only difference between observe and auto?
en.answer: No. Observe does not accept work, create a Worker, or reproduce the issue. Auto can start proactive work after policy checks.
en.step0Explanation: The system reads an allowed environmental event. It is not yet an explicit human instruction.
en.step1Explanation: Semantic assessment follows admission. A positive observe assessment records would_accept without starting work.
en.step2Title: Only an admitted branch starts work
en.step2Explanation: Auto with an enabled matching rule can create work. Exploration costs compute even if it produces nothing useful.
en.step3Explanation: A simple fix, an unreproduced issue, and a product decision are distinct outcomes. Usefulness and permission for external action both matter.
